args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of v2.3.1, checkout-api was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. Its staging build, v2.3.1-rc, was also marked unhealthy. Rolled checkout-api back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy and the error rate is 0.2%. Next step: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before deploying it again.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and the service is healthy again.

- **Why v2.3.0:** v2.3.1 was the version failing health checks, with an 18% error rate in us-east, us-west and eu-west. v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was marked healthy in production.
- **After the rollback:** all three regions run v2.3.0, health checks pass and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, and it paged the on-call engineer.

The staging build of v2.3.1 (v2.3.1-rc) was also marked unhealthy before it went to production. The incident notes that the cause of the v2.3.1 failure needs to be found before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
